seo.description: Free checklist for the 59 Disney Lorcana Promo Set 3 cards, with images, prices and binder pages. No ads, no sign-up, no tracking.
seo.ogDescription: Track all 59 Disney Lorcana Promo Set 3 cards. Free, with no ads, no sign-up and no tracking.

about.title: About the Promo Set 3
paragraphs: Promo Set 3 lists the 59 Disney Lorcana promo cards numbered 1/P3 to 60/P3, from products and promotions, organised play, Disney Cruise Line and Disney parks and stores.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
